title: grindelia squarrosa var. integrifolia
intro: Grindelia squarrosa var. integrifolia, commonly known as gumweed or tarweed, is a perennial plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is native to the western regions of North America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs. The health benefits of Grindelia squarrosa var. integrifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve congestion and reduce coughing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions as an expectorant and anti-tussive agent.
